notes:
Narrative verdict is project-level. Replication model prints no p values; no p calculated. Domain coding uses purity versus harm; interaction coefficient sign differs from original coding. Model reports convergence warning.
Completion source review (n_o): N = 177 is the explicitly stated final Study 1 participant sample after 12 attention-check exclusions and 12 duplicate-pilot-worker-ID exclusions. These participants supplied the repeated moral judgments analyzed by the Study 1 mixed model, with participant and scenario random intercepts. N denotes participant clusters, not the number of judgment observations or scenarios; no observation total or N from degrees of freedom is inferred. Both domain and dosage vary within participants. No sample arithmetic was needed. Critical model specification: we analyzed the data with a linear ... mixed model fitted using restricted maximum likeli- ... hood. ... the random intercepts of ... scenario and participant.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Printed b coefficient for the domain main effect, harm versus purity severity in the Study 1 model without the interaction. Description and study identify this test independently of row ordering or numerical matches. The p value is preserved as p = .625.
